annotation.summary_en: A friendly traffic police officer stops a driver not to issue a ticket, but to give highly detailed advice on road conditions and the best local kebab spots.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch takes place on a tree-lined rural road during the day, where a traffic police officer, Lieutenant Grigoryan, has pulled over a black BMW X5. The driver, wearing a patterned shirt, listens as the officer leans into the car window. Instead of the usual interrogation or fine, the officer politely advises the driver to drive carefully for the next 100 meters because there is another police post ahead, after which he can drive however he likes. As the driver prepares to leave, the officer repeatedly stops him to offer more 'friendly' advice, warning him about road quality and suggesting he take the left path to save his car. Finally, he recommends a specific roadside 'object' (eatery) where they serve excellent kebab, telling the driver to stop for five minutes to eat. The sketch ends absurdly as the officer breaks into a distorted rendition of 'I Will Always Love You,' gesturing wildly and running down the middle of the road while the driver reacts with exaggerated laughter and puts on sunglasses.
catchphrases: Ընդաաաաա իյա իյաաաայ, վի լոյվիզ լայվյուուուուու, վի լոյվիզ լայվյուու
